address: Avenida del Libertador 405, Buenos Aires, C1001ABE, Argentina

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Behind this funny name, onomatopoeia that reminds us of the whistle of the first trains, hides a unique gastronomic proposal, as it lives inside the National Railway Museum! You will find a pleasant outdoor terrace and a bright glass-fronted dining room (offering views of both an old wooden carriage in the museum and the modern towers of the Retiro neighbourhood) that is striking not only for its setting, but also for its large marble counter where you can eat, with several tables arranged like the inside of a train and some more details from the world of railways. The proposal, under the charge of chef Facundo Kelemen (who also sets the menu at Mengano), is that of a simple but well-catered-for Argentininan cuisine, somewhat casual and with a specific section for grilled dishes. Everything we tried was delicious, but we recommend the carpaccio of pork loin with tapenade or their ragu and béchamel lasagna. The service couldn't be friendlier!
